name: social_linkedin_comment_outbound
prompt:
The script output above is the JSON summary of the LinkedIn growth commenting run (run_linkedin_comments.py): it found candidate posts, drafted a comment in Vishal's voice for each, and posted only those the relevance judge scored 4/5 or higher. Do not run anything yourself; only format that output for WhatsApp.

If "posted" has entries, for each one:
💬 <author>: "<post_snippet, first 100 chars>"
   → <comment>  (relevance <relevance>/5)
   <url>

If "rejected" has entries: one line each, "✋ Judge refused <author> (relevance <relevance>/5)".
If "errors" has entries: one line each, "❌ <author> — <reason>".
End with one line: "LinkedIn comments: X posted, Y skipped by voice, Z candidates". Skipped posts are expected and are not a problem; do not list them.
If "note" says the daily cap was reached or the run was skipped because the Chrome profile was busy, say that in one line.
If "posted", "rejected" and "errors" are all empty: respond with exactly [SILENT].
